class.name: OpenXRFrameSynthesisExtension
class.brief_description: Retained OpenXR frame synthesis API. Frame synthesis is unsupported in EGP.
class.description: This class exposes the [url=https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XR_EXT_frame_synthesis]OpenXR Frame synthesis extension[/url] API. The upstream extension uses advanced reprojection techniques to inject additional frames at reduced application framerates. [b]Note:[/b] Frame synthesis is unsupported by EGP's Forward+ renderer. Enabling the extension does not provide frame synthesis in EGP, even when the XR runtime supports it.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if frame synthesis is enabled in the project settings and supported by the renderer and current XR runtime. EGP's Forward+ renderer does not support frame synthesis. The value returned will only be valid once OpenXR has been initialized.

method.name: skip_next_frame
method.description: Queues the next frame to be skipped when supplying motion vector and depth data. Call this after teleporting your player or a similar action has moved the player to prevent incorrect reprojection results due to this movement.

members.member: Requests frame synthesis when supported by the renderer and XR runtime. EGP's Forward+ renderer does not support this feature.

If [code]true[/code] this informs the XR runtime we will be providing frames at a greatly reduced rate. Enable this when you expect your application to run at low framerates and wish to inject multiple reprojected frames.
